findings: The actual assembled oblique view shows separate pin heads, ring and three ring-bolt stations enclosing the previously modeled large planetary gears. The carrier-only view shows the connecting sleeves and stand-offs; those cast contours are inferred.
The horizontal cutaway exposes the two support groups in their saved assembly placement. Most planet axes lie outside this section; it cannot reproduce the composite two-pin presentation of Plate22.

The separate actual pin-axis section shows an integral hollow pin, separate bronze bush and steel sleeve, the ring at one end and a recessed castle nut/cotter at the carrier. This view is cropped and transformed for inspection only; the saved native assembly is unchanged.

Original SNL137/126/156 correct the preparatory nut mark to M313 and plug size to half an inch. Original SNL43/44 and HB122 support M282 large and M272 small bronze bushes, while the conflicting SNL251/252 assembly rows are retained.

The first projecting carrier-pad trial put the nut seat at local Y591mm. The final recessed seat at Y529.227142857mm projects to the approximate source x849 pick. Circular access-pocket size, shoulder shapes and casting transitions remain inferred; coincidence with the chosen pick is not independent validation.

The modeled pin diameter28mm is close to the conditional27.577mm source pick. Printed gear dimensions retain planet-center radius142.875mm versus approximately131.354mm from the lower illustrated pin, leaving an11.521mm radial discrepancy.

The upper ring bolt is substantially inboard of its illustrated position: model radius202mm, approximately261.257mm at source y200 under the retained scale. The source carrier outer rim/pin-ring contours and current gear-case envelope require reconstruction before this fixture can be accepted for integration. Nominal clearances do not resolve this source discrepancy.

Blind pin drilling and separate domed plug are present, but the complete oil path and expansion sealing are absent. Smooth thread envelopes and formed round-leg cotters do not establish original threads, clamp loads, exact stock volume or historical running fits.
accepted_scope: Nominal static pin/support and retention geometry only. Carrier/ring source radial discrepancy requires revision; no historical-fit, full uncertainty, motion, load or standard-integration acceptance.
next: Review carrier outer rim and pin-ring/bolt radial station against Plate22 and HB Plate73 before integration; then continue the small train and central bevel/input assemblies.
